feed.title: dark_websites — a reference database of the useful, lesser-known web
feed.subtitle: New finds from the dark_websites reference database.

entry.title: xeno-canto
entry.summary: A collaborative archive of hundreds of thousands of wildlife sound recordings from around the world. (niche, deep)

entry.title: tldr pages
entry.summary: Community-maintained cheat-sheets for console commands — the practical examples man pages forgot. (narrow, niche)

entry.title: tilde.town
entry.summary: A public unix server and gentle art community — hundreds of hand-made ~user pages on one shared computer. (obscure, kitsch)

entry.title: textfiles.com
entry.summary: Jason Scott's archive of tens of thousands of BBS-era text files — the writing culture of the pre-web internet. (obscure, deep)

entry.title: ooh.directory
entry.summary: A browsable directory of thousands of personal blogs, sorted by topic and freshness. Blog discovery, solved. (obscure, broad)

entry.title: oimo.io
entry.summary: A collection of exquisitely engineered physics toys and simulations by a single Japanese developer. (kitsch, niche)

entry.title: iNaturalist
entry.summary: Photograph any living thing and a community of naturalists (plus a model) identifies it — citizen science at scale. (niche, broad)

entry.title: endless.horse
entry.summary: An ASCII horse whose legs scroll on forever. That's it. That's the site. (kitsch)

entry.title: earth.nullschool.net
entry.summary: A hypnotic live visualization of global wind, ocean currents and weather on a spinnable planet. (niche, deep)

entry.title: eBird
entry.summary: Cornell's global birding database — live sightings, hotspot maps and migration data from millions of checklists. (niche, deep)

entry.title: crontab.guru
entry.summary: Paste a cron expression and get it back in plain English. The quick reference for schedule syntax. (narrow)

entry.title: Zombo.com
entry.summary: The infinite promise of the year-2000 web, preserved. You can do anything at Zombo.com. (kitsch, obscure)

entry.title: WorldCat
entry.summary: Search the catalogs of tens of thousands of libraries worldwide and find which one near you holds the book. (broad, narrow)

entry.title: Wolfram|Alpha
entry.summary: A computational answer engine — ask it math, dates, units, nutrition or physics and get worked results. (broad, narrow)

entry.title: Windows 93
entry.summary: A fully interactive parody operating system in your browser, packed with absurd apps and easter eggs. (kitsch, obscure)

entry.title: VirusTotal
entry.summary: Scan a file or URL against dozens of antivirus engines at once. First stop for anything suspicious. (narrow, deep)

entry.title: TinEye
entry.summary: Reverse image search that finds where a picture came from and how it's been modified. (narrow)

entry.title: Tildes
entry.summary: A non-profit, ad-free link community engineered for depth of discussion over engagement. (obscure, niche)

entry.title: The Useless Web
entry.summary: One button that teleports you to a random gloriously pointless website. The web's best worst tour guide. (kitsch, narrow)

entry.title: SunCalc
entry.summary: Sun position, sunrise, shadows and golden hour for any spot on the map, any day of the year. (narrow)

entry.title: Stellarium Web
entry.summary: A planetarium in the browser — the night sky from your location, any time, any date. (narrow, niche)

entry.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
entry.summary: The gold standard of free scholarly reference — peer-reviewed, constantly updated articles on all of philosophy. (deep, broad)

entry.title: Standard Ebooks
entry.summary: Public-domain classics re-typeset to modern professional standards, free in every format. (niche, deep)

entry.title: Squoosh
entry.summary: Drag in an image, compare compression codecs side by side, and shrink it without shipping it to a server. (narrow)

entry.title: SomaFM
entry.summary: Listener-supported, commercial-free internet radio with dozens of hand-curated channels. (niche)
